description: Warsha dependency updates. Nothing is ever auto-merged: CI must be green and a human merges every PR. Goose bumps get their own label and always need the full workspace suite.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates per manager into one reviewable PR; a human still merges it after CI is green.
Major updates stay in their own PR so breaking changes get a dedicated review.
prBodyNotes: Major update: read the upstream changelog and expect breakage. Not auto-merged.

packageRules.description: Goose is the agent engine. Track and label every bump.
Goose major/minor bumps are never auto-merged and need the full test suite green first (see DECISIONS.md).
prBodyNotes: Goose major/minor bump: `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace` and the desktop smoke tests must all be green before this merges.

packageRules.description: Goose patch bumps stay manual too, but they are the only Goose PRs a human may fast-track once CI is green.
GitHub Actions pins are reviewed like code: no floating refs and no auto-merge.
Keep Tauri, React and Vite on the same major train to avoid mixed-version desktop builds.

customManagers.description: The Goose dependency in the root Cargo.toml is commented out until its crate APIs settle. This manager still watches the pinned tag so the placeholder never silently rots.
